com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Enum MarketDepth.TYPE

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<MarketDepth.TYPE>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth.MarketDepth.TYPE
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<MarketDepth.TYPE>
    Enclosing interface:
    MarketDepth
    Deprecated.

    @Deprecated
public static enum MarketDepth.TYPE
extends java.lang.Enum<MarketDepth.TYPE>
    These are the types/views of MarketDepth records are available. More types will be added in the future. The client is responsible for maintaining the types of MarketDepth they subscribe to. One important difference between the types is the comparing two MarketDepth object logic. Look out for Comparison logic inside each type for further details.
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

    • Enum Constant Detail

      • LEVEL_II

        public static final MarketDepth.TYPE LEVEL_II
        Deprecated. 
        NASDAQ Level II (QuoteView) Use this type to access NASDAQ Level II Market Participant information. This information pertains to the data provided by NASDAQ QuoteView data feed. The data comes back for operations only on ADD/UPDATE. The consumer is responsible for DELETE and CLOSE by looking at the values of MarketDepth.Record e.g. Ask price. If the price is 0 then do not show them to the user. Sample symbol: IBM

      • TOTAL_VIEW

        public static final MarketDepth.TYPE TOTAL_VIEW
        Deprecated. 
        NASDAQ SuperMontage ViewSuite: TotalView Use this type to access NASDAQ Prime feed information. This information pertains to the data provided by the TotalView offering and includes aggregate data. Sample symbol: IBM

      • NYSE_OPEN_BOOK

        public static final MarketDepth.TYPE NYSE_OPEN_BOOK
        Deprecated. 
        OpenBook shows each quote, by price, including data on the market maker ID and number of round lots available at that price. OpenBook is NYSE equities only. Sample symbol: IBM
